capabilities: Assign a loading mode to each plugin
Load plugins on command, view or file trigger
Edit modes in bulk from a searchable plugin table
Rebuild cached commands and view types
extras: Monkey-patches Obsidian internals, so Obsidian updates may break behavior. Inline/embedded views such as Dataview inline queries are not supported. Keeps up to three backup generations of community-plugins.json and warns when that file is changed by Sync, Git, the CLI or another plugin.
problem: Obsidian loads every enabled community plugin at startup, so a large plugin set makes launching the app slow.
summary: Plugin manager that delays loading community plugins until their commands, views or files are used, to keep startup fast.
